ch10.label: 1.6HA
ch10.notes: CH10 / 1.6HA: live chord mode on the piano roll (double-tap SEQ): chord pads, Rhythm, recording, diatonic types, Bars encoder; Euclid lanes in the piano roll; meters after the channel strip. Select is confirmed working on the device; the newest features are still being tested on hardware. Not a certified stable release.
